mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Temperatures are at 35 degrees with a feel of 28 under clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail, accompanied by a waning gibbous moon. Note that while the International Space Station passes overhead tonight, clouds will block the view.

The City Clerk's Office announced that candidate registration information is now available for the 2027 Spring Election. Seats across all four aldermanic districts will be on the ballot, and interested candidates must submit their completed paperwork by 5:00 PM on January 5th, 2027.

Today features several great local events, including The Crafty Fair at ART House 360 from 10 AM to 4 PM, plus live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard, Paddy Mac's, and Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead, Hop Haus Brewing Co. and Lake Lou-ee will host trivia nights next Tuesday.

In weekly police news, on Wednesday, November eleventh, officers responded to Whalen Road and South Main Street after a woman was flagging down bystanders requesting 911 be called. She was taken into custody for bail jumping after officers determined she was under the influence of alcohol.
If you are planning a lunch or dinner run, Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM with Mint Cookie as today's flavor of the day.
